externalPrerequisites.description: Referenced 307-behavior Notion research report; no report located in the audited workspace.
Independent clean macOS, Windows 11 x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x64 installations.
Consented physical microphone/screenshots and representative import/audio/image evaluation datasets.
Eligible Notion/provider accounts and reachable authenticated HTTPS test environment; authenticate through supported product flows.
Apple signing/notarization access and model redistribution evidence.

items.title: Exclude trashed-only attachments from portable exports
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: A trashed-only or otherwise unreferenced private asset is absent from current-content exports; a shared asset still referenced by a live page remains present; Markdown/CSV and HTML exports behave consistently. Verify archive bytes, not just manifest counts.

items.title: Restore meeting history when transcript segments still exist
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: Ordinary meeting restore and recovery after transcript deletion both pass. Test existing, edited, deleted, stale, and unauthorized segments; preserve timing and audio references; do not rewind unrelated records.

items.title: Preserve rich formatting and links during table and layout edits
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: Import a cell and layout paragraph containing bold text and links, change one character through the visible control, save, reopen, undo/redo, export, and restore. Unaffected formatting and targets remain intact. Test the actual change handlers, not only serialization helpers.

items.title: Open the correct linked database view on its owning page
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: Two pages can display different filtered views of one collection; each opens with its own configuration. Multiple views on the same page remain distinct while sharing the same records through rename, move, restart, and restore.

items.title: Make copied block links navigable
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: A copied link pasted into another page opens and focuses the correct block. External launch routing is tested in the packaged app. Missing/deleted targets and unavailable workspaces produce useful errors. Existing search-citation navigation remains functional.

items.title: Correct nested toggle visibility and collapse persistence
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, live asset graph, recovery and page/view identities
items.acceptance_scenario: A toggle containing nested lists, paragraphs, and technical blocks hides all descendants; reopening restores them intact. Save/reopen, moving children, and undo/redo preserve the agreed collapse behavior.

items.title: Complete simple table structure controls
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Users can grow and shrink tables without dropping populated cells silently; header rendering, undo, import, export, and restart preserve structure. P1 merge/unmerge continues to preserve original cell content.

items.title: Add rich-text colors and highlights
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Supported colors/highlights survive editing, mixed paste, undo, restart, and portability. Older content remains compatible; unsupported incoming values are retained safely.

items.title: Finish code and image block controls
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Controls work in the packaged app, source bytes remain unchanged, settings survive restart/round trips, and file access remains scoped to managed IDs.

items.title: Connect workspace Q&A to hybrid retrieval
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Paraphrased/conceptual questions retrieve relevant differently worded notes. Scope restrictions, current-source checks, deleted evidence, memory invalidation, and citation navigation remain correct. Include a real local-model/desktop acceptance case.

items.title: Decode and normalize common uploaded audio
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Supported MP3/M4A/AAC and ordinary stereo/44.1/48 kHz WAV inputs are normalized and transcribed locally. Keep originals; bound resource use; deny arbitrary network inputs; support cancellation/retry and recoverable unsupported/corrupt inputs. Publish the exact supported codec matrix.

items.title: Provide schema-aware historical value restoration
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: A schema change exposes incompatible old values in a preview; the user can map or deliberately retain them as evidence. Applying restoration creates a new revision, preserves the current recovery point, and does not rewind shared schemas or unrelated records.

items.title: Complete database query scaling and virtualization
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Large representative collections load incrementally with bounded memory and visible-row rendering. Typed filters, formula/rollup behavior, stable sorting, scopes, and cursor invalidation remain correct. Measure bridge/paint as well as service time; do not reuse page-search benchmarks as database-view evidence.

verification.service_or_interface: targeted development checks passed; integrated Go suite 416 passed / 14 optional checks skipped; release evidence pending

items.title: Honor core view configuration and calendar range editing
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Property order, width, visibility, sort/group configuration, and calendar ranges survive restart and linked-view use. Resizing changes duration through guarded mutations and preserves timezone semantics.

items.title: Resolve semantic index implementation and scale
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Exact model/hash/dimension generations are maintained; incompatible changes rebuild derived indexes without affecting notes; scope/revision checks hold; large-corpus latency and memory meet the declared benchmark profile.

items.title: Resolve the backup snapshot contract
items.interface_boundary: Versioned content, database queries, recovery snapshots, model generations and native workers
items.acceptance_scenario: Concurrent edits and recording remain within documented responsiveness bounds; database/asset consistency, cancellation, insufficient disk, crash recovery, staged restore, and source preservation pass. Do not label existing backups corrupt solely because their implementation differs.

items.title: Complete reviewed workspace-agent actions
items.interface_boundary: Retrieval evidence, model capabilities, memory freshness and reviewed proposals
items.acceptance_scenario: A representative natural-language task becomes an understandable proposal, is applied only through approved scoped services, and handles cancellation, stale revisions, retries, failure, and partial progress without duplicate effects. Code and arbitrary shell commands are never executed by default.

items.title: Qualify context budgeting and every exposed AI mode
items.interface_boundary: Retrieval evidence, model capabilities, memory freshness and reviewed proposals
items.acceptance_scenario: Long inputs have useful bounded behavior and explicit omissions; code replacement cannot drop omitted source; malformed outputs stay drafts; citations resolve to supplied current evidence; no silent cloud fallback. Record correctness, citation validity, latency, memory, and correction effort rather than relying only on schema-valid output.

verification.service_or_interface: All 14 fixed writing/structured modes pass on ab3ff13 with optional 7B pack; exact-token/typed-source/schema boundaries and strict memory/held-out cases have separate scoped evidence. Previous failures retained; no broad quality or release qualification.

items.remaining_qualification: Representative long-context and mode task sets, actual user correction effort, controlled latency/concurrency/full application memory and native candidate/platform journeys remain open. The 14 fixed cases are not general quality approval.

items.title: Qualify memory and semantic related-content workflows
items.interface_boundary: Retrieval evidence, model capabilities, memory freshness and reviewed proposals
items.acceptance_scenario: Memory improves the declared task set without overriding newer authoritative records; stale/forgotten entries remain excluded during concurrent changes, including entries restored in those states; decisions cite evidence. Explain that restoring an older backup can recover earlier memory states: forgetting does not retroactively erase historical backups. Semantic and lexical suggestions are distinguishable and scope-safe. Existing memory lifecycle services remain the foundation.

verification.service_or_interface: Original strict factual/memory and four held-out cases pass with optional 7B pack106; previous 1.5B failures retained. Broader mode/task/native quality remains unqualified.

items.remaining_qualification: Broader memory preferences/constraints/source edits/deletion/forgetting and semantic relevance across representative data remain open. Strict fixed and held-out passes with the optional 7B pack do not erase smaller-model failures or qualify native/platform behavior.

items.title: Complete managed Claude Code execution

items.acceptance_scenario: A supported real account completes a scoped task; denied tools, interrupted output, process failure, stale changes, revocation, and disconnect are handled correctly. Native filesystem/shell capabilities cannot bypass Trove permissions. Do not copy subscription credentials or enable the mode before containment is enforceable.

items.title: Complete managed Codex execution

Credentials remain out of logs/workspace/model prompts. API billing is never an automatic fallback.

items.title: Add reviewed MCP page and task creation

items.title: Complete the supported remote MCP route

items.title: Qualify provider handoffs and client interoperability
items.interface_boundary: Shared proposals, scoped grants, provider lifecycle and owning-kernel bridge
items.acceptance_scenario: Handoffs exclude secrets, hidden reasoning, unrelated history, and uncommitted changes. Resume remains provider/account/version compatible. One active mutating provider run is enforced; duplicate retries cannot repeat effects. No unannounced provider/billing/context switch occurs.

verification.service_or_interface: Scoped lifecycle/handoff/approval fixtures and real installed runtime discovery/initialization evidence exist; authorized inference, compatible completed-turn resume and cross-provider handoffs remain unqualified.

items.remaining_qualification: Real authorized clients, completed/interrupted-turn resume, cross-provider handoffs, revocation and repeated/interrupted requests need current account/client evidence; Windows/Linux managed containment remains unavailable.

items.title: Freeze and identify the final release candidate
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Source/bundle hashes remain stable through qualification; required checks cannot pass through missing/skipped evidence; candidate-specific limitations and approval state are explicit.

items.title: Finish native end-to-end acceptance
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Record actual user-visible behavior on that exact build, including restored content and selected workspace. Mocked-browser/service fixtures cannot substitute for native observations. Resolve the previously interrupted final-candidate checks.

verification.service_or_interface: be6fc81 narrow native save/format/navigation/reopen observed; formatted-word search failed. Full native acceptance remains open.

items.title: Qualify physical audio and screenshot capture
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Device/user-consent outcomes are visible and recoverable; captured originals survive interruption; no unrelated private audio/screen content is used as a fixture. System-audio capture remains separately platform-qualified and need not block a microphone/upload-first release.

items.title: Validate real migration and meeting datasets
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Reconcile every discovered item, compare meaningful source content and asset bytes, report source omissions, and measure task/transcript quality. Repeated public speech and fixture HTTP servers remain useful regression inputs but do not establish general fidelity or live-account compatibility.

items.title: Qualify complete installation and model-pack paths
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Core app installation needs no Node, Python, Ollama, Docker, database server, or product account. Installed packs support offline AI/transcription. Backup/restore succeeds on a second clean installation. An empty PATH on the development Mac is not equivalent evidence.

items.title: Finish distribution, update, and recovery qualification
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Published artifacts have verified hashes and reproducible manifests; upgrades and rollback preserve canonical data; failed updates retain recoverable state; uninstall does not delete workspaces without an explicit request. Keep the current ad-hoc build labeled as such until these checks pass.

verification.service_or_interface: migration/recovery, reviewed update kit and rollback launch fixtures passed; actual ad-hoc app correctly rejected by production verifier

items.remaining_qualification: Source includes full pre-migration snapshots, app signature/identity verification, external recovery kits, compatible restore and explicit guarded previous-app launch. Actual signed app pairs, startup-ready acknowledgement, public distribution, physical power-loss, independent clean-machine update/rollback and uninstall qualification remain open.

items.title: Benchmark realistic end-to-end performance
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Verify the declared approximately-two-second shell, under-300-ms common keyword search, under-one-second hybrid retrieval excluding optional reranking, and responsive editing against the agreed profiles. Record limits honestly; a 100-page hybrid benchmark or 10,000 simple pages is not evidence for all workloads.

verification.service_or_interface: be6fc81: 20 readiness returns; startup threshold failed at 8399.656 ms. Synthetic keyword and 100-page actual hybrid targets passed within recorded service scope; 10k typed formula/rollup remain measured limits.

items.title: Add regression coverage for the audit gaps
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Tests fail on the audited behavior and pass after the fix. Use independent expected outcomes and archive/content inspection; avoid tests that simply repeat implementation logic. Run affected existing suites and real integration paths before closing an item.
items.remaining_qualification: Preserve the be6fc81 formatted-word search failure and add a source regression/candidate retest; ongoing audit, model, native, device and platform regressions remain required.

items.title: Qualify additional platforms separately
items.interface_boundary: Immutable candidates, platform support and acceptance evidence
items.acceptance_scenario: Publish platform-specific supported features and evidence. Do not infer cross-platform readiness from Go portability or the macOS build.

verification.service_or_interface: Native worker, decoder, capture, OCR, packaging/routing, credential, file-identity, private-storage and Windows document-helper sources exist; cross-compilation/host fixtures do not establish target execution.

items.remaining_qualification: Actual Windows/Linux native builds and execution, device/screenshot capture, WebView/PDF behavior, provider containment, clean install/update/rollback/uninstall and full product matrix remain open. Windows new-workspace creation, migration, backup, restore and transfer explicitly unavailable pending directory/marker durability protocol.

items.title: Establish source control and coordinated integration
items.interface_boundary: Source control, pinned tools, ownership, requirements and evidence ledger
items.acceptance_scenario: Changes have reviewable history, shared baseline updates reach dependent workstreams, integrated checks run before promotion, and no user data/secrets enter commits. This documentation task does not itself initialize Git.

items.title: Make development and qualification reproducible
items.interface_boundary: Source control, pinned tools, ownership, requirements and evidence ledger
items.acceptance_scenario: A new contributor can provision the pinned toolchain and run checks without another chat's temporary environment. Record exact native build inputs and distinguish build dependencies from end-user runtime requirements.

items.title: Reconcile the requirements ledger and completion claims
items.interface_boundary: Source control, pinned tools, ownership, requirements and evidence ledger
items.acceptance_scenario: Native editing, import reconstruction, fallback preservation, and verification are separate claims. A passing verification family does not close unimplemented breadth. Preserve historical reports; publish a new assessment for new evidence.

verification.service_or_interface: Current overlay accounts for every original ledger ID and links all 51 backlog items to scoped sources/evidence or an explicit unresolved state; historical ledger statuses remain unchanged.

items.remaining_qualification: Ongoing candidate/platform reconciliation and missing research remain open; mapping to implementation packages does not close entire acceptance criteria.

items.title: Obtain and reconcile the referenced research evidence
items.interface_boundary: Source control, pinned tools, ownership, requirements and evidence ledger
items.acceptance_scenario: Each accepted behavior has traceable evidence or an explicit unresolved state. Missing source wording is not invented. Research proposals do not become accepted features automatically. The CodeSwitchOS documents are design precedent, not a prerequisite for fixing known product defects.
items.remaining_qualification: Referenced 307-behavior research remains not supplied; no source wording or completion is invented.

items.title: Resolve selected-stack deviations explicitly
items.interface_boundary: Source control, pinned tools, ownership, requirements and evidence ledger
items.acceptance_scenario: Implement the selected contract or record an explicitly accepted ADR with behavior, maintenance, security, licensing, offline, and qualification consequences. A different library is not automatically a user-visible bug; silently claiming exact TRD conformance is not acceptable.

verification.service_or_interface: Selected audited components now wired in production source; source-specific targeted checks pass; candidate/platform/distribution qualification remains separate.

items.title: Qualify and optionally expand local image intelligence
items.interface_boundary: Versioned image/review capabilities, jobs, source manifests and reviewed mutations
items.acceptance_scenario: Use representative images and document quality/resource limits. Additional handwriting, scanned-PDF, rotation, or language support is required only when explicitly selected. Images remain local unless the user separately invokes an external integration.

items.title: Decide whether personal review needs generative analysis
items.interface_boundary: Versioned image/review capabilities, jobs, source manifests and reviewed mutations
items.acceptance_scenario: Preserve occurrence deduplication, activation consent, current-source/memory checks, reviewed writes, and failure isolation. Do not rename a digest as autonomous task management or introduce unreviewed knowledge rewriting.

items.title: Qualify declared P2 package boundaries
items.interface_boundary: Versioned image/review capabilities, jobs, source manifests and reviewed mutations
items.acceptance_scenario: Conversation fixtures preserve branches/roles/timestamps/provenance; graph associations disclose evidence; calculations and submissions remain canonical; operational settings stay inert on portable import; host authentication/TLS/ownership transfer/recovery remain correct. Arbitrary remote infrastructure, network filesystems, and offline multi-device sync are not implied by the existing host tests.

verification.service_or_interface: Declared packages exist; 4900d4b packaged offline P2 fixtures verify chart values, confirmed actions, graph citations, conversation branches/original bytes, display settings, backup/reopen and inactive portable operational settings. A separate be6fc81 packaged P2 rerun passed its recorded scope; that candidate still fails startup and formatted-word search.

items.remaining_qualification: Complete P2 package, model, hosted environment, native interface and per-platform gates remain open. Packaged fixture coverage is not general P2 or release approval.
